# Bundled game assets

Cars, road, metal guardrails and trees: Kenney Racing Kit, Creative Commons Zero (CC0).
Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/racing-kit
Original license: KENNEY-LICENSE.txt

Renderer: Three.js r170, MIT license. See ../vendor/THREE-LICENSE.txt.

All runtime assets are bundled locally for offline Android play.

Pedal and control illustrations: project-created SVG artwork.


Graphics upgrade
- Touring car: Guido Odendahl; material extensions Eric Chadwick, via Khronos glTF Sample Assets. CC0. https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/main/Models/ToyCar
- Nature Kit and Watercraft Kit: Kenney, CC0. https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit · https://kenney.nl/assets/watercraft-kit
- Asphalt 02: Rob Tuytel / Poly Haven, CC0. https://polyhaven.com/a/asphalt_02
- Aerial Grass Rock: Rob Tuytel / Poly Haven, CC0. https://polyhaven.com/a/aerial_grass_rock

- Textured palms, pines, birches and maples: Quaternius Ultimate Stylized Nature Pack, CC0. https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimatestylizednature.html · Mobile copies prepared from the public mirrors agentkaerf/FreeModels and walterpalladino/godot-quaternius-ultimate-stylized-nature; leaf/bark textures resized to 1024px.
- Aerial Beach 01: Rob Tuytel / Poly Haven, CC0. https://polyhaven.com/a/aerial_beach_01


## Route scenery
Detailed city facade modules, scanned cliff/boulder models,2K PBR surface materials and HDR skies are from Poly Haven (CC0). See [route asset credits](routes/CREDITS.md) for authors and original asset links. Route card images are in-game captures.

Detailed garage models: see cars/CREDITS.md for creators, source links, CC BY 4.0 license and modifications.
